name: NO MOUSE SENSITIVITY PENALTY IN RAID!
teaser: NO MOUSE SENSITIVITY PENALTY IN RAID!
description_html:
Description: This mod let you get rid of all the in-raid sensitivity penalty (including sprinting, jumping and carrying weight). Your mouse sensitivity will not gradually decrease due to looting stuff in raid. No longer need to change your DPI mid-game, no longer need a football field sized mousepad!

Intall: unzip the downloaded file into your sptarkov folder.

What is the difference between this mod and MOUSE PENALTY FIX or KIKI-ARMORDEBUFREMOVER ?

These two mods both remove the fixed mobility penalty caused by equipment (e.g. armor, helmet, etc), but don’t work for in-raid sensitivity penalty (sprinting, jumping and carrying weight). My mod, on the opposite, eliminate the in-raid sensitivity penalty, but the gear penalties are still remained. BSG uses different methods to impletement these penalties.

If you want to completely get rid of mouse sensitivity penalty. You can use my mod with MOUSE PENALTY FIX or KIKI-ARMORDEBUFREMOVER together for best experience.

Version: this mod works for 3.7.x spt version.

Mod Compatibility: The compatibility of this mod is not fully tested. It works without problem on my side (I have 30+ mods installed), so it is probably fine. If you encounter any incompatibility, feel free to report the issue, your feedback will make the mod better.
